about.title: Attribution and licence
about.lead: The meshes and CT on the temporal-bone page are the ZETA right temporal bone from the OpenEar library. The written notes have not been reviewed.
about.openearBody: Human temporal-bone models published by Sieber et al. in Scientific Data (2018). The paper and the Zenodo data are CC BY 4.0. Attribution, a change notice, and the licence link stay on this page and in the footer.
about.obligation1: Credit Sieber et al., the OpenEar library, Sci Data 2018.
about.obligation2: Say if you changed the material. The bone and sinus/dura meshes are decimated. The other meshes keep their original vertex counts.
about.obligation3: Keep the licence name and link (CC BY 4.0).
about.sampleBody: The glb files are Draco-compressed OpenEar meshes in RAS millimetres. The CT is a 0.25 mm isotropic webp stack. Semicircular canals and the jugular bulb were not segmented and come in stage 1.5. Sigmoid sinus/dura is semi-transparent by default because it may mix the sigmoid sinus with middle-fossa dura, and that label is unverified.
about.vorBody: Z-Anatomy assets planned for the VOR page are CC BY-SA. Share-alike means derivatives that include those assets must be shared under the same terms, with attribution. Keep OpenEar (CC BY) credit separate from Z-Anatomy credit.
about.reviewBody: There are two badges. 미검증 means not yet checked. YS 검수 완료 means the review is done. When geometry changes, bump model_version and set the related copy back to 미검증.
